what.text: This page follows refugees from Slovakia in all host countries, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 625 Slovak refugees, and Canada hosted 63.2% of them.
After Canada, the largest hosts are France, Germany and Sweden.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Slovakia, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2005 to 2006 and 2016 to 2021.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1994 at 12 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 1426, at the end of 2021.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
